description:
Show or clear a presence indicator in a chat — sends NO message.
state: 'composing' = "typing…", 'recording' = "recording audio…", 'paused' = stop showing it.
WhatsApp clears it by itself after a few seconds; repeat at most every ~3 s while still typing, and send 'paused' when done.
Only visible while this account has a live connection (realtime inbox / inbound webhook on).
name: whatsapp_send_presence
